stories.title: What really happened in Ceuta? Why we may never find out
stories.description: Hundreds of migrants have again attempted to cross from Morocco into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. This time, Moroccan officials fended them off, raising new questions about the crossing of July 30.

stories.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

stories.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
stories.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
stories.description: Iran's proxy says it hit a ship with Saudi military equipment in the Red Sea, as tensions over the US-Iran war remain high.

stories.title: Trump demands Iran ‘put up the white flag of surrender’ as MoU expires
stories.description: President also claims US is in direct contact with IRGC, denies a rush to end conflict ahead of November's US midterms.

stories.title: Iran signals readiness for ‘US ground operations’ as MoU expires
stories.description: Iran's more offensive posture follows Trump's comment that the US would soon make the Strait of Hormuz its territory.

stories.title: Yemen’s drone war: Rivals flex growing aerial muscle
stories.description: Houthi and government forces exchange drone attacks, marking a major shift in war tactics.

stories.title: US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding expires: How and why it fell apart
stories.description: Trump deemed the MoU 'over' within a month of it being signed, as the two sides traded attacks despite a 'ceasefire'.

stories.title: Iran says it will escalate if U.S. does not honour deal within weeks
stories.description: If the U.S. does not meet that deadline and diplomacy fails, Tehran ‌would conduct a “timely and precise” military attack to break the U.S. naval blockade on ‌the Islamic Republic, the official added

stories.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it gets in way of Iran deal: report
stories.description: Iranian and Omani officials have been talking for weeks on future maritime navigation arrangements through the shipping route, and the Foreign Ministry in Tehran said earlier August 17, that the two sides were working on a joint declaration

stories.title: Israel vows to go after Hezbollah as it names another killed
stories.description: "No score will be left unsettled in any arena. We'll defend our soldiers and our civilians with full power," Defence Minister Israel Katz

stories.title: West Asia war highlights: Saudi authorities issue warning for Jazan province along Yemen border
stories.description: Iran offers a $30,000 bounty for killing, capturing U.S. soldiers; Israel vows to go after Hezbollah as it names another killed

stories.title: Iran offers $30,000 bounty for killing, capturing U.S. soldiers
stories.description: There has been no known deployment of U.S. ground forces in Iran during the West Asia war, except for a rescue mission in April for a downed American airman

stories.title: Iran executes man over involvement in winter protests
stories.description: Iranian authorities reported more than 3,000 deaths, attributing the violence to "terrorist acts" orchestrated by the United States and Israel, while rights groups based abroad maintain that security forces fired on protesters

stories.title: Japan needs to maintain relations with Russia including in energy sector — expert
stories.description: Taisuke Abiru said that Russia is deeply dissatisfied with the strengthening of Japan’s ties with NATO and Ukraine, and is signaling that it may respond to Tokyo’s continued sanctions

stories.title: Iran denies communication channels with US exist — agency
stories.description: The IRGC spokesman said that Donald Trump "is lying"

stories.title: Support for Ukraine, anti-Russia sanctions taking toll on Latvia’s economy — politician
stories.description: Riga can no longer turn a blind eye to the economic costs associated with supporting Kiev and anti-Russian sanctions, Ainars Slesers said

stories.title: Houthis claim strike on Saudi warship in Red Sea
stories.description: According to the statement, the ballistic missile strike was accurate
